description: Report what this account still needs to get value from freehire: a CV (and whether reading it has finished), job-search preferences, an active job alert, and — only needed for applications prepared on the person's behalf — a paid plan and the switch letting connected agents apply. Returns each step with done or not, which preferences are missing, and next_step: the one thing to do now, as a tool name or a page URL to send the person to. Takes no arguments.
name: get_setup_status
title: Check my freehire setup
